agents.name: Software Reverse Engineering Agent
agents.description: An agent capable of performing long and complex software reverse engineering tasks by delegating work to multiple other agents

skill.name: Software reverse engineering tasks
skill.description: Help with complex and multi-step software reverse engineering tasks

agents.name: Architecture Contract Validator Intermediate Agent
agents.description: Intermediate agent that validates flows, use-cases, and architectures against a desired architecture using extractor evidence provided by caller context. It must not call the architecture extractor directly and can use PEC agents only as narrow fallback.

skill.name: Architecture contract validation
skill.description: Validate if a flow, use-case, or architecture is violating architectural contracts based on the desired architecture
examples: Validate if this use-case flow violates our clean architecture contracts
Given this desired architecture, identify contract violations in the current implementation

agents.name: Architecture Contract Extractor Intermediate Agent
agents.description: Intermediate agent that extracts a high-level architecture view scoped to the analyzed use-case and discover/infers expected architecture rules for downstream validation. It is the required first step before Architecture Contract Validator for architecture evidence gathering.

skill.name: Architecture contract extraction
skill.description: Recover scoped architecture elements/relations for a specific use-case and infer likely architecture contracts expected for the system.
examples: Extract the architecture involved only in this use-case and infer expected architecture rules
Given this flow, recover the related architectural components and relationships for contract validation

agents.name: Use Case Specialist Agent
agents.description: Discovers, analyzes, and explains the implementation of a specific use case. It supports two operating modes: default for concise, high-level overviews and specific for focused, detailed investigations of a requested flow, rule, exception, or dependency.

skill.name: Use case information discover
skill.description: Discovers and explains a specific use case in either default mode for high-level overviews or specific mode for focused, detailed investigations of a requested flow, rule, exception, or dependency.
examples: Give me information about the execution flow of the use case 'X'. Return with it a high abstraction level sequence diagram.
Given this flow of usecase 'Y', recover the related architectural artifacts.
Use default mode for a concise overview of the use case 'Z'.
Use specific mode to inspect the exception flow of use case 'Z' in detail.

agents.name: Metrics Primary Extractor Component
agents.description: Help with raw metrics software data

skill.name: Uses SCC software in order to extract metrics from target software
skill.description: Help with raw metrics software data
examples: I need metrics from software located at './'
Give me data about the project located at './folder/extraction_project'

agents.name: Artifact Primary Extractor Component
agents.description: Help with artifact related file content extraction

skill.name: Uses powershell commands to navigate through folders and extract artifacts related to the request
skill.description: Help with the extraction of content from codebase related to the user's request
examples: I need the files related with class 'UserController'
Help me recover the content from the file './RegisterView.java'.

agents.name: Diagram Specialist Primary Extractor Component
agents.description: Generates diagrams (primarily using mermaid DSL) based on prompted information

skill.name: Diagram generation
examples: I need the class diagram of classes related to 'UserController'
